core_features_per_joint.rotation_residual: first two matrix rows minus identity, 6D; root relative to upright reference
core_features_per_joint.position_residual: fixed neutral skeleton FK relative to upright reference, divided by reference leg length, 3D
core_features_per_joint.direction_residual: unit bone direction minus reference; root uses local up direction, 3D

shoulder_feature: one scalar: left minus right shoulder height, subtract neutral baseline, divide by reference leg length
scale: mean left/right hip-knee-ankle reference leg length
reference_body: neutral SMPL-X asset, fingerprint in run bindings; not claimed identical to fitting asset
world_coordinate: z-up after explicit native y/z conversion, horizontal yaw removed
output: full 263D HumanML motion, including head and arms
